## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This review found no defects in the reviewed scope. The new `--exclude` flag follows the project's `cli-flags` and `logging` skill rules, and the added tests cover the basic exclusion path, more than one pattern, the empty default and the end-to-end archive path.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that removes files from `collect` when their basename matches any pattern, using `fnmatch`. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds tests for the behaviour, and adds a one-line text fixture at `tests/fixtures/hostile-review.txt`.
